tagline: 柯达便携相机，1994 年发布
description: 柯达于1994年推出的便携相机。配备38–60 mm f/4,3–6,4 (4 elements/4 groups with one aspheric element)。快门速度1/40–1/500 s. Electronic self-timer.。感光度DX coded films from ISO 25–3200.。240 zone active autofocus, 0,6 m to infinity.。

specs.镜头: 38–60 mm f/4,3–6,4 (4 elements/4 groups with one aspheric element)
specs.对焦: 240 zone active autofocus, 0,6 m to infinity.
specs.曝光测光: Programmed exposure from EV 6 (1/8 s, f/2,8) to EV 17 (1/430 s, f/17).
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, flash range (ISO 100) 4 m (wide) 2,8 m (tele) Red-eye reduction.
specs.英文简介: Kodak Star 1075z is a cheap compact camera with a (very basic) zoom lens not usually find in its price class.
